ADVERTISEMENT
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites online application
from Citizens of India for filling up 05 (five) posts of Laboratory Assistant (Civil), Gort.
Polytechnic under the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Arunachal Pradesh in the
Pay Matrix level-6 (< 35400-1124001-) Group B (Non Gazetted) Non Ministerial.
Details of vacancy position and reservation of posts are given below:
(A) HOW TO APPLY
(1) Before filling the Online Application Form for the post advertised, a candidate must
mandatorily register for ONE TIME REGISTRATION (OTB.
(2) Those who have already registered in OTR need not register again and they can directly
login to fill up online form using the same user ID and password.
(3) Candidates are required to apply online on https://appsc.gov.in. Detailed instructions for One
Time Registration (OTR) and Online Application are available on the APPSC website
(trttps:ilappsc.gov.inl. The applicants are advised to submit only single application, however,
if due to any unavoidable situation, he/she submits another/multiple applications, the
application with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted by the Commission.
Therefore, the highest RID application should be complete in all respects. The fee paid
against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID.
(4) Applicants in Government Service should also apply directly on the APPSC website. Such
applicants have to upload a copy of intimation submitted to their respective Heads of
Department or NOC issued by the department.
NOTE: The onHne application submission link shall be active from 1700 hours on
23.0g.2024 till last Oate of submission i.e. before 1700 hours on 1"5.09.2A24 on the APPSC
website.

SCANNED DOCUMENTS AND INFORMATION TO BE UPLOADED

(F) APPLICATION FEE
(l) APST candidates are required to pay fee of {150/- (Rupees One Hundred Fifty) only.
(2) PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per Section 19 of the
Arunachal Pradesh Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018.
(G) LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OFAPPLICATION: -15.09.2024 (1700 Hours).
(H) ON THE DAY OF THE INTERVTEWVTYA-VOCE:
Eligible candidates will have to produce the above-mentioned (at Point E)
Certificates/Documents and Mark Sheets in original at the time of interview, failing
which he/she will not be allowed to appear in the interview.
NOTE:
(1) The decision of the Commission as to the eligibility or otherwise of candidate for
admission to Recruitment test/Interview or selection will be final and no coffespondence
or personal enquiry will be entertained.
(2) In case the number of applicants is more than the desired ratio, the Commission may
conduct a Recruitment Test, the details of which will be notified separately.
(3) Recruitment Test, if conducted, shall be objective or subjective examination in concerned
subject.
(4) Date for the Recruitment Test/Written Examination/ Interview of the eligible candidates
will be intimated seParatelY.
(5) The tentative date for the examination is scheduled on30.11.2024.
(6) The syllabus for the examination will be made available on the Commissions website.
(7) The Selection will be provisional subject to verification of requisite documents/
qualifications by the indenting department'
(g) In case of pwBD candidates, the selection process will be as per the Rights of Persons
